list.memo:
Today's class was fantastic! We worked on including the s sound for plural nouns and verbs.  Please watch and practice with the video links below:
1)   Singular and Plural Nouns - s, es, and ies endings video:  https://youtu.be/UJNsuNMTvgE?si=gAj9F7jSEZJszX5m

list.memo: This lesson we reviewed recycling in Korea and related vocabulary. Reviewed the expressions [fall/autumn, chutes /shoots/ ] and sounded out the pronunciation of [rubbish /RUH·buhsh, ph- /f/, hazardous /HA·zr·duhs/, contaminated, biodegradable  ]. Answered questions about how you usually recycle and described the typical procedure for waste pick-up. Here are today's notes:

subList.better: Some buildings have a system that connects

subList.better: Usually we separate into three

subList.better: It is inconvenient

subList.better: If the recycled product is a plastic bottle I think it is best to wash and throw the contaminated one in the trash

subList.better: Throw it away in the recycling bin
